title: Spec Suggested Review Order: two draft_handler.gleam line anchors point at the wrong code
evidence: spec line 211: '[`draft_handler.gleam:141`](../../server/src/application/draft_handler.gleam#L141)' for 'The whole feature in one handler' — but `awk NR==141` yields '    Ok(pog.Returned(_, [vacancy, ..])) ->' (inside lookup_accepting_vacancy, fn starts line 134); the first handler `pub fn handle_save_draft(` is at line 164. spec line 254: '[`draft_handler.gleam:358`](../../server/src/application/draft_handler.gleam#L358)' for 'resumed_at stamps on re-engagement save' — but `awk NR==358` yields '            }'; the stamp + comment are at lines 281-292 ('// Same re-engagement stamp as the plain save path.' at 281) and 200-210 on the save path.
detail: Two of the spec's twelve code anchors land inside a lookup helper and on a closing brace respectively, sending reviewers to the wrong lines in the handler they are meant to read first.
recommended_fix: Repoint draft_handler.gleam:141 to :164 (handle_save_draft) and draft_handler.gleam:358 to the resumed-stamp call (~:205 or :281).

title: Byte-identical fakeTimers() helper duplicated across the two new JS test files
detail: Both files were added in this PR; AGENTS.md's DRY rule (extract when logic repeats 2+ places) applies to test helpers too — a timer-semantics tweak must now be made twice.
